releaseNotes:
Warrior TV Player 0.9.1

- Clearer messages when adding a provider: "Server name not found — check the spelling" when the server name doesn't exist, and "The server refused the connection" when the server turns the connection down. Wrong-login and expired-account messages are unchanged.
- The Esc key on a keyboard now works as Back.
- Long release notes in the update window can be read to the end with the remote: press Up to select them, then Up and Down to scroll.
